notes: CAD subset with imported reference-model articulation template. NOT photos-only reconstruction.
Eleven nominal structural components from supplied STEP; 259 other leaves omitted, including 11 empty leaves. Servos, fasteners, electronics and camera geometry are not represented.
All part placements and joint pivots at reference q=0 come from Pinned Menagerie SO101 f3b6013629c7b94f8ee93fd977b161fa8350f9bc. Original STEP placements are preserved in inventory.json.
Grouping is an explicit template proposal. CAD/source correspondence uses the earlier nominal local-frame comparison; there is no fitted scale or geometry deformation.

Root clearance +0.15 m is assumed for a free-space motion test; not a measured mounting height. Hardware zeros/signs, gripper 0-100 conversion, mounting, mass distribution and servo dynamics remain unverified.
Masses are sourced full-link estimates including hardware whose visuals are omitted. Box collisions and uniform-box inertia remain approximations; generated dynamics may fail validation.
Joint sliders and FK comparison verify conversion consistency with the same template, not independent physical accuracy.

API workflow candidate: all common-reference part poses and group frames translated together +0.10 m from the original reviewed input. Relative geometry, joint axes/limits, source mesh bytes and physical parameters retained. Select convex_mesh and exclude_joint_pairs explicitly for export; uniform-box inertia remains approximate.
